The nursery, filled with trays of dry compost beneath cracked glass, suggests an environment for cultivation, despite its current state of disuse. A door to the north leads to the furnace, possibly a source of heat or perhaps a tool for another process. The colonnade stretches to the east, hinting at an expansive layout of this mysterious place. My focus has been on gathering utility from the items present, securely carrying the trowel and twine with me.
